risk_if_not_implemented: Without Position Categorization, trusted insiders may misuse access or act on conflicts of interest without detection or deterrence. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Unaddressed Security / Compliance Exposure (R-GV-2), and most likely increases susceptibility to Dysfunctional Management Practices (MT-8), Human Error (MT-9), Workforce Shortage / Loss of Critical Skills / Labor Disruption (MT-25).

compensating_control_1.name: Defined Roles & Responsibilities
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to define cybersecurity roles & responsibilities for all personnel.
compensating_control_1.justification: Defined Roles & Responsibilities (HRS-04) provides overlapping security capability that compensates for the absence of Position Categorization (HRS-03) by addressing related risk objectives through an alternative control mechanism aligned with People applicability. Given the people-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to enforce Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) for Technology Assets, Applications, Services and/or Data (TAASD) to restrict access to individuals assigned specific roles with legitimate business needs.
compensating_control_2.justification: Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) (IAC-06) provides access control enforcement that compensates for the absence of Position Categorization (HRS-03) by restricting system and data access to authorized users through alternative identity and access mechanisms. Given the people-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
